definition.en: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for promoting international cooperation on atmospheric science, climatology, hydrology, and related geophysical sciences.
definition.hi: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for promoting international cooperation on atmospheric science, climatology, hydrology, and related geophysical sciences.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, the WMO is critical as it provides the scientific framework for climate-resilient economic planning and disaster risk reduction. Understanding its role helps in analyzing how global weather data impacts India's agriculture, water security, and disaster management policies.
